title: Preserve fitted matrix coordinates in TangentPCA transforms
body:
## Description

TangentPCA chooses its matrix feature representation during fitting, but later operations infer that representation again from different data. A rotation-matrix model fitted at the identity stores full skew-matrix coordinates and then tries to reconstruct them as symmetric matrices because the identity is symmetric. Rectangular matrices are reshaped to squares. A symmetric query can also switch a model fitted with full matrix coordinates to a shorter feature vector.

Use the fitted feature count and the manifold shape to distinguish full matrix coordinates from the compressed symmetric representation. Apply that same choice in both transform and inverse_transform, and reconstruct the manifold's actual shape. A model fitted with compressed symmetric coordinates explicitly rejects nonsymmetric tangent vectors instead of dropping their lower triangle. No new fitted state or dependency is introduced.

The regressions exercise actual fit_transform, transform and inverse_transform calls on SO(2), SO(3), 2-by-3 and 3-by-2 matrix spaces, and symmetric queries following a full-matrix fit.

## Validation

[Successful NumPy and Autograd validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/geomstats/actions/runs/43667286823) checks candidate `c8772938c30ca073463ea4341a1ee9d2f1717aaf` against base `2fc8e25eb8955767292552f9c0c1438be362ba8f`.

- Restoring the original production file while retaining the new tests produces six expected failures on each backend: five matrix transformation/reconstruction regressions and the explicit-error guard.
- All learning modules and the Matrices, SpecialOrthogonal and SPD geometry modules, excluding the repository's slow/redundant profiles:
  - NumPy: 1,348 passed, 7 skipped, 1,724 deselected, 2 expected failures and 3 non-strict expected-failure cases that passed.
  - Autograd: 1,351 passed, 5 skipped, 1,724 deselected, 4 expected failures and 1 non-strict expected-failure case that passed.
- Configured Ruff 0.4.8 lint/format checks and all applicable changed-file pre-commit hooks pass.
- The workflow restores the exact candidate source after the baseline comparison and verifies that checks do not modify it.

Python 3.13.18, NumPy 2.5.4, Autograd 1.9.1, SciPy 1.18.1 and scikit-learn 1.9.1 on Ubuntu. The complete repository, slow profiles and PyTorch execution were not run. The independent validation workflow is kept off this contribution branch.

## Related work

The existing TangentPCA proposals #1513 and #1878 address metric weighting of principal directions. This change preserves the fitted feature representation and does not alter that weighting. The earlier ToTangentSpace skew-coordinate dimension change affects a different class and is not included here.

## Checklist

- [x] Clear title and focused production change.
- [x] Added native regression tests using public estimator methods.
- [x] Vectorized transformations are preserved.
- [x] Affected NumPy and Autograd test scopes pass.
- [x] Formatting and applicable pre-commit hooks pass.
- [x] Documented the fitted-coordinate helper and linked related work.
- [ ] Complete repository test suite on every backend.
